scenario: okf adapter recognize(component, file) for every file in tests/fixtures/bundles/okf-sample/ (the frozen v0.1 fixture the adapter unit/integration suites already drive). type comes straight from frontmatter (no directory gate, §5.1); reserved index.md/log.md are excluded at every depth.
adapterStatus: IMPLEMENTED — src/core/adapter/adapters/okf-adapter.ts (WI-A, chunk-2). Unlike the other nine format-family goldens in this directory (authored ahead of their adapters as spec-authored targets), OKF is the one BUILT-FIRST adapter with an already-extensive unit/integration suite (tests/core/adapter/okf-adapter.test.ts, tests/integration/okf-conformance.test.ts); this golden captures its REAL, already-shipped output rather than an aspirational target, added late (#730) because OKF was "the only registered adapter without one" per scripts/lint-goldens-presence.ts triage.
specSource: docs/architecture/specs/akm-0.9.0-bundle-adapter-spec.md §5 (the reference OKF adapter) + §5.1 (BINDING: type from frontmatter, no directory gate) + §9 (links).
realWorldSource: https://github.com/GoogleCloudPlatform/knowledge-catalog/blob/main/okf/SPEC.md — the upstream OKF v0.1/v0.2 spec this adapter implements
tests/fixtures/bundles/okf-sample/ — a small, conformant OKF bundle (BigQuery Table / Metric / default-knowledge concepts) used by every OKF adapter test
notes: type is read verbatim from frontmatter with NO directory gate: tables/orders.md and tables/customers.md both carry the free-form type 'BigQuery Table' even though they live under tables/; metrics/wau.md carries 'Metric'; guides/onboarding.md carries no type: field at all and defaults to 'knowledge' (§5.1).
conceptId = path within the component root minus .md (tables/orders.md -> tables/orders); ref = <bundle>//<conceptId>.

name <- title (fallback: last path segment when title is absent, not exercised by this frozen fixture -- see tests/core/adapter/okf-adapter.test.ts for that synthetic case). description <- description. tags <- tags. updated <- timestamp (this v0.1 fixture predates the v0.2 generated/verified/sources/status/stale_after family added by #730 -- see tests/fixtures/bundles/okf-sample-v2/ and tests/core/adapter/okf-adapter.test.ts's 'v0.2 provenance family' describe block for that coverage, deliberately kept OUT of this frozen recognition golden so the byte-identical v0.1 fixture stays byte-identical).

links resolve BOTH OKF forms (/-rooted bundle-relative and standard relative) into component-root-relative conceptIds: guides/onboarding.md links to both tables/orders and tables/customers; tables/orders.md links to tables/customers (twice, deduped) and metrics/wau; metrics/wau.md links back to tables/orders; tables/customers.md links to tables/orders. hash is a sha256 hex digest over the full raw file (frontmatter + body).

index.md, log.md, and the nested tables/index.md are recognized (excluded) as OKF reserved structural files at every depth (§5, OKF §1.4/§3.1) and are NEVER indexed as concepts -- recognize() returns null for all three.

index.md.reason: reserved OKF structural file (root index.md, §5) -- never a concept regardless of frontmatter

log.md.reason: reserved OKF structural file (update log, §5) -- never a concept regardless of frontmatter

tables/index.md.reason: reserved OKF structural file at a NESTED depth (§5) -- the reservation is not root-only
